text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a Crypt.
source_text: You see a Crypt.

text: 你看见一个土窟人。
source_text: 你看见一个土窟人。

text: You see a ganger.
source_text: You see a ganger.

text: 你看见一个领头的。
source_text: 你看见一个领头的。

text: Welcome to the gang, man.
source_text: Welcome to the gang, man.

text: 嘿，欢迎来到黑帮。
source_text: 嘿，欢迎来到黑帮。

text: We Crypts will bury those Fools.
source_text: We Crypts will bury those Fools.

text: 我们土窟人将会埋葬那些愚人。
source_text: 我们土窟人将会埋葬那些愚人。

text: I'm glad you're on on our side.
source_text: I'm glad you're on on our side.

text: 我很高兴你站在我们这边。
source_text: 我很高兴你站在我们这边。

text: With your help, we can kill them Fools.
source_text: With your help, we can kill them Fools.

text: 有了你的帮助，我们就能杀掉那些愚人。
source_text: 有了你的帮助，我们就能杀掉那些愚人。

text: This town is all ours now.
source_text: This town is all ours now.

text: 这个城镇现在是我们的了。
source_text: 这个城镇现在是我们的了。

text: I like your style.
source_text: I like your style.

text: 我喜欢你的风格。
source_text: 我喜欢你的风格。

text: You gotta get yourself some leather. You a Crypt now.
source_text: You gotta get yourself some leather. You a Crypt now.

text: 你该给自己弄些皮革，你现在是土窟人了。
source_text: 你该给自己弄些皮革，你现在是土窟人了。

text: We don't want your kind around here, Fool.
source_text: We don't want your kind around here, Fool.

text: 我们不需要你这种人，笨蛋！
source_text: 我们不需要你这种人，笨蛋！

text: Get out, before we throw you out.
source_text: Get out, before we throw you out.

text: 滚出去，不然我们就把你扔出去。
source_text: 滚出去，不然我们就把你扔出去。

text: If you start any trouble, the whole Crypt will come down on you.
source_text: If you start any trouble, the whole Crypt will come down on you.

text: 如果你要惹麻烦，所有的土窟人都会来对付你。
source_text: 如果你要惹麻烦，所有的土窟人都会来对付你。

text: You made the wrong choice. Now you gonna be buried.
source_text: You made the wrong choice. Now you gonna be buried.

text: 你作了错误的选择，现在你要被活埋了。
source_text: 你作了错误的选择，现在你要被活埋了。

text: What are you doing here?
source_text: What are you doing here?

text: 你在这儿做什么？
source_text: 你在这儿做什么？

text: Scrapheap belongs to us.
source_text: Scrapheap belongs to us.

text: 废渣堆属于我们了。
source_text: 废渣堆属于我们了。

text: In Scrapheap, if you ain't with us, you are either a loser or a Fool. What are you?
source_text: In Scrapheap, if you ain't with us, you are either a loser or a Fool. What are you?

text: 在废渣堆，如果你不加入我们，那你就是个失败者或愚人，怎么样？
source_text: 在废渣堆，如果你不加入我们，那你就是个失败者或愚人，怎么样？

text: You talking to me? Are you talking to me?
source_text: You talking to me? Are you talking to me?

text: 你和我说？你是在和我说话吗？
source_text: 你和我说？你是在和我说话吗？

text: This ain't no game, man. You either a Crypt or you gonna be buried.
source_text: This ain't no game, man. You either a Crypt or you gonna be buried.

text: 这并不是开玩笑，你要么是土窟人要么被埋掉。
source_text: 这并不是开玩笑，你要么是土窟人要么被埋掉。

text: Only Crypts got the right to wear leathers.
source_text: Only Crypts got the right to wear leathers.

text: 只有土窟人才有权穿上皮革。
source_text: 只有土窟人才有权穿上皮革。

text: Run, Fools, while you still have a chance to live.
source_text: Run, Fools, while you still have a chance to live.

text: 快跑，笨蛋，你还有活下来的可能性。
source_text: 快跑，笨蛋，你还有活下来的可能性。

text: Hey, Rayze, hunting season just openned, and Fools are on the list of dumb animals.
source_text: Hey, Rayze, hunting season just openned, and Fools are on the list of dumb animals.

text: 嗨，雷兹，狩猎季节开始了，愚人们在我们的愚蠢动物的名单上。
source_text: 嗨，雷兹，狩猎季节开始了，愚人们在我们的愚蠢动物的名单上。

text: Hey guys, leave a Fool for me to kill.
source_text: Hey guys, leave a Fool for me to kill.

text: 嗨伙计们，留一个愚人给我杀。
source_text: 嗨伙计们，留一个愚人给我杀。
